adat.title: Adat Dalem Tamblingan
adat.subtitle: The Catur Desa around Lake Tamblingan, Buleleng
adat.body1: The Adat Dalem Tamblingan community is a traditional indigenous society living across the Catur Desa — Gobleg, Munduk, Gesing, and Umejero — around Lake Tamblingan in Buleleng Regency, Bali. Rooted in the ancient Tamblingan civilization, they uphold Piagem Gama Tirta, an ancestral value system that honors sacred water (tirta) as the source of life and cosmic balance.
adat.body2: Lake Tamblingan is regarded as a sacred landscape protected through the alas kekeran system (forbidden/protected forest), reflecting harmony between people and nature. Daily life is guided by customary institutions and spiritual leaders who preserve tradition and lead rituals at ancestral temples.
adat.caturBody: Gobleg, Munduk, Gesing, and Umejero form the Catur Desa — a shared customary territory that safeguards Tamblingan’s ecological and spiritual balance. Although each village stands as its own administrative unit today, in adat (customary) terms the four remain one Adat Dalem Tamblingan region.
adat.valuesTitle: Guardians of water, forest, and ancestral heritage
adat.valuesBody: At the heart of Adat Dalem Tamblingan life is the reverence for water and the stewardship of Alas Mertajati, the sacred forest surrounding the lake. Through customary institutions, ritual practice, and local wisdom passed down through generations, the community continues to care for the lake, forest, and sacred sites — keeping them as both a source of life and a spiritual center for generations to come.

kkn.title: Mekar Banjar
kkn.subtitle: UGM KKN-PPM Period II 2026 — Munduk & Gobleg
kkn.hook: This is not a visit. We came to bridge Tamblingan’s living wisdom with knowledge villagers can still hold long after we leave.
kkn.why1: In Banjar District — especially Munduk and Gobleg — rare strengths sit side by side: the headwaters and ecology of Lake Tamblingan, the customary forest of Alas Mertajati, and flagship crops like clove and coffee. The landscape is primed for sustainable growth, and just as vulnerable when modernization outruns local capacity to steward it.
kkn.why2: Mekar Banjar 2026 stands in that gap. Land restoration, health services, waste systems, early weather warnings, creative economy, and youth education — all aimed at keeping Alas Mertajati and Lake Tamblingan as foundations of wellbeing without stripping away adat meaning.
kkn.theme: Accelerating local community competence, optimizing environmental systems, and sustaining the customary ecosystem — through a multidisciplinary approach in Munduk and Gobleg.
kkn.themeNote: The overarching theme that holds every program together.
kkn.pillar1Body: Strengthening villagers, youth, students, and local enterprises so inherited knowledge meets skills they can use immediately.
kkn.pillar2Body: Addressing landslide risk, waste, and readiness infrastructure so the villages stay resilient against weather and modern pressure.
kkn.pillar3Body: Protecting sacred living space — water, forest, and legal clarity — so development never erases Tamblingan’s identity.
kkn.programsSubtitle: Each title is a working promise — cross-disciplinary by design, built to keep living in the villages after the KKN period ends.
kkn.progRelasiMeaning: REVITALISASI LAMAN SISTEM INFORMASI - KOLABORASI NARASI, ENTRI, KONTEN PADA SISTEM INFORMASI
kkn.progRelasiBlurb: This website you are browsing is the result of this work program — a digital face for the region that is faster, easier for villagers to manage, and ready to introduce Tamblingan’s tourism and culture to the world.
kkn.progRakitBlurb: From plastic banks to sorting literacy: a community movement that turns plastic piles into collective action.
kkn.progSaehBlurb: Accompanying customary-law issues, civil registration, and lake protection so legal certainty stays in dialogue with adat values.
kkn.progSparkMeaning: School Program for Awareness, Readiness & Knowledge
kkn.progSparkBlurb: Interactive learning from elementary to senior high — tolerance, financial literacy, AI, and career exploration — so young people arrive more ready.
kkn.progGemparBlurb: Hands-on MSME mentoring: diagnosing bottlenecks, digital branding, and marketing that helps local products get found.
kkn.progGaraBlurb: Community education and pet vaccination — protecting people by breaking transmission chains at village level.
kkn.progSigapBlurb: Balanced-nutrition education and local food use to help prevent stunting in Munduk and Gobleg.
kkn.progCakraBlurb: A shared climax: contests, arts, and stage with villagers — celebrating Banjar culture while lifting local MSMEs.
kkn.clustersSubtitle: Village problems rarely stand alone. So we arrive as one team across four clusters — complementary, not four silos working apart.
kkn.clusterSoshumHint: Law, management, accounting, and economics — for adat advocacy, literacy, and MSME competitiveness.
kkn.clusterSaintekHint: Engineering, biology, instrumentation, and computer science — for readiness infrastructure, waste systems, and the village’s digital face.
kkn.clusterMedikaHint: Nursing and pharmacy — for health services, reproductive education, and field medical collaboration.
kkn.clusterAgroHint: Plant protection, soil, food tech, and veterinary care — for clove health, nutrition, and a safer village against rabies.
